name.text: Shared: Round a whole number to a specified place value

questiontext.text:
Round the number \[ {@number@} \] to the nearest {@place_name@}.

[[input:ans1]] [[validation:ans1]] [[feedback:prt1]]

generalfeedback.text:
Worked solution

We are rounding \[ {@number@} \] to the nearest {@place_name@}.

The rounding place has value \[ {@place_value@}. \] Look at the digit immediately to its right.

The correct rounded value is \[ \boxed{{@answer@}}. \]

PVRS-02

number-sense

whole-number-rounding

foundation

numeric-rounding

Learners round a multi-digit whole number to the nearest ten, hundred, or thousand.

Distinguishes correct rounding from simple truncation at the requested place.

Original STACK question. Interaction design was informed by open rounding-question patterns. No source wording or mathematical content is copied.

Curriculum alignment is maintained outside the question source.

prtincorrect.text: Check the digit immediately to the right of the place you are rounding to.

node.description: Checks whether the learner truncated instead of rounding.

truefeedback.text:
It looks like you removed the digits after the requested place instead of rounding.

Look at the next digit: if it is \(5\) or greater, increase the rounding digit by \(1\).

falsefeedback.text: Identify the requested place, then inspect the digit immediately to its right.

qtest.description: Teacher answer should receive full credit.
Truncation misconception should receive zero credit with targeted feedback.
